answer: The pulse assignment is published and spiral records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the vault graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4114 identities would post 3812 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
